508 function splitList(token) {
509   const delim = path.delimiter;
510   let parts = token.split(delim).map((s) => s.trim()).filter(Boolean);
511   if (parts.length === 1 && delim !== ',' && token.includes(',')) {
512     parts = token.split(',').map((s) => s.trim()).filter(Boolean);
513   }
514   return parts;
515 }
516 
517 function tryParseJson(s) {
518   if (typeof s !== 'string') return s;
519   try {
520     return JSON.parse(s);
521   } catch {
522     return null;
523   }
524 }

526 /**
527  * status — Strip-first pointer; Face only if needed for top-k display.
528  * @param {object} opts
529  */
530 export function verbStatus(opts = {}) {
531   const roots = opts.roots ?? [];
532   const top_k = opts.top_k ?? 3;
533 
534   // Portfolio status when roots provided
535   if (roots.length > 0) {
536     const discovered = discoverStrips({ roots, envValue: opts.envValue ?? null, env: opts.env });
537     const ranked = rankPortfolioStripFirst(discovered.strips, { top_k });
538     return {
539       ok: true,
540       spelling: SPELLING,
541       verb: 'status',
542       primary: 'status',
543       mode: 'portfolio',
544       strip_first: true,
545       face_loads_for_status: 0,
546       face_required_for_rank: false,
547       active_effort: ranked.ranked[0]?.active_effort ?? null,
548       human_wait: ranked.ranked[0]?.human_wait ?? null,
549       next_recommended: ranked.ranked[0]?.next_recommended ?? null,
550       why_next: ranked.ranked[0]?.why_next ?? null,
551       portfolio: ranked,
552       discovery: {
553         empty: discovered.empty,
554         count: discovered.strips.length,
555         face_full_reads: discovered.face_full_reads,
556       },
557       message: 'Portfolio status from Strip projections only',
558     };
559   }
560 
561   const project_path = resolveProjectPath({
562     project: opts.project,
563     cwd: opts.cwd,
564   });
565   const surfaces = opts.surfaces ?? loadProjectSurfaces(project_path);
566   if (!surfaces.strip && !surfaces.face) {
567     return {
568       ok: false,
569       error: 'no_face_or_strip',
570       spelling: SPELLING,
571       verb: 'status',
572       project_path,
573       message: 'No Face or Strip found for status',
574     };
575   }
576 
577   const strip = surfaces.strip;
578   const proj = strip ? toStripProjection(strip, { project_path, strip_source: surfaces.strip_source }) : null;
579 
580   // Face only when top-k display needs narrative color (optional single load)
581   let face_display = null;
582   let face_loaded = false;
583   if (opts.include_face || opts.drill_face) {
584     if (surfaces.face?.narrative) {
585       face_display = surfaces.face.narrative;
586       face_loaded = true;
587     }
588   }
589 
590   // TW1: Roadmap projection is engine truth. Face prose alone is an honest
591   // gap (empty projection) — status never invents steps from narrative.
592   let roadmap;
593   const roadmapLoaded =
594     opts.roadmap !== undefined
595       ? { ok: true, exists: opts.roadmap != null, roadmap: opts.roadmap }
596       : loadProjectRoadmap(project_path);
597   if (roadmapLoaded.ok && roadmapLoaded.exists) {
598     const validated = validateRoadmap(roadmapLoaded.roadmap, {
599       allow_unevented_steps: true,
600     });
601     roadmap = validated.ok
602       ? {
603           present: true,
604           valid: true,
605           projection: validated.projection,
606           steps_count: validated.steps_count,
607           gap: null,
608           invented_steps: false,
609         }
610       : {
611           present: true,
612           valid: false,
613           projection: [],
614           error: validated.error,
615           drift: validated.drift,
616           gap: 'roadmap_silent_rewrite',
617           invented_steps: false,
618         };
619   } else {
620     roadmap = {
621       present: false,
622       valid: null,
623       projection: [],
624       gap: surfaces.face ? 'face_prose_only' : 'no_roadmap',
625       invented_steps: false,
626     };
627   }
628 
629   return {
630     ok: true,
631     spelling: SPELLING,
632     verb: 'status',
633     primary: 'status',
634     mode: 'project',
635     strip_first: true,
636     project_path,
637     strip_source: surfaces.strip_source,
638     face_loaded,
639     active_effort: proj?.active_effort ?? strip?.active_effort ?? null,
640     human_wait: proj?.human_wait ?? strip?.human_wait ?? 'none',
641     next_recommended: proj?.next_recommended ?? strip?.next_recommended ?? null,
642     why_next: proj?.why_next ?? strip?.why_next ?? null,
643     capacity: proj?.capacity ?? strip?.capacity ?? 'unknown',
644     phase: proj?.phase ?? strip?.phase ?? null,
645     negative_heartbeat: proj?.negative_heartbeat ?? strip?.negative_heartbeat ?? null,
646     tool_depth_cell: strip?.tool_depth_cell ?? null,
647     face_display,
648     roadmap,
649     pointer: {
650       active_effort: proj?.active_effort ?? strip?.active_effort ?? null,
651       human_wait: proj?.human_wait ?? strip?.human_wait ?? 'none',
652       next_recommended: proj?.next_recommended ?? strip?.next_recommended ?? null,
653       why_next: proj?.why_next ?? strip?.why_next ?? null,
654     },
655     message: 'Status from Strip-first pointer',
656   };

678       ok: true,
679       spelling: SPELLING,
680       verb: 'next',
681       primary: 'next',
682       mode: 'portfolio',
683       strip_first: true,
684       face_loads_for_rank: ranked.face_loads_for_rank,
685       face_required_for_rank: face_used,

687         project_id: r.project_id,
688         project_path: r.project_path,
689         next_recommended: r.next_recommended,
690         why_next: r.why_next,
691         active_effort: r.active_effort,
692         human_wait: r.human_wait,
693         score: r.score,
694         reasons: r.reasons,
695         capacity: r.capacity,
696         face_loaded: false,
697       })),
698       ranked,
699       discovery: {
700         empty: discovered.empty,
701         count: discovered.strips.length,
702         face_full_reads: discovered.face_full_reads,
703       },
704       message: face_used
705         ? 'ERROR: portfolio next consulted Face (should never)'

707     };

712     project: opts.project,

718       ok: false,
719       error: 'no_strip',
720       spelling: SPELLING,
721       verb: 'next',

723       message: 'N=1 next requires a Strip projection',
724     };
725   }

728     project_path,

732   return {
733     ok: true,
734     spelling: SPELLING,
735     verb: 'next',
736     primary: 'next',
737     mode: 'project',
738     strip_first: true,
739     project_path,
740     face_loaded: false,

742     next: [
743       {
744         project_id: proj.project_id,
745         project_path,
746         next_recommended: proj.next_recommended,

748         active_effort: proj.active_effort,

762 /**
763  * update / heartbeat — Face narrative rewrite + Strip append; never rewrite Strip history.
764  * @param {object} opts
765  * @param {string} [opts.verb_name='update']
766  */
767 /**
768  * W4 of the steward revision (2026-09-28): repair as a proposal (his Q2, "propose the tidying too").
769  *
770  * `--repair-propose --after-step <id> [--after-presentation <id>]` — composes the correction set that follows an
771  * acceptance from the records alone (`composeRepairProposal`: the waits that named the accepted step; the slices
772  * whose pin on it went stale) and appends it as ONE `repair_proposal` event anchored at the roadmap's last seq.
773  * Nothing on any step changes. The SAME set already open for that step (the same presentation and rows) is
774  * answered, not duplicated; a different one — a later acceptance — supersedes the open set (`repair_resolve`
775  * disposition `superseded`, no step written) and the new composition follows, even when it is empty; an empty
776  * set appends no proposal (there is nothing for him to accept). A refinement fold that throws fails the propose:
777  * never a partial set (Grok W4).
778  *
779  * `--repair-resolve <proposal_id> --disposition accepted|dismissed --who <name> [--why <text>]` — his word. On
780  * `accepted` each correction still true of the roadmap (`planRepairApply`) is applied FIRST as a receipted
781  * `step_set` naming the proposal, then the `repair_resolve` is appended with the ids that landed; a failed
782  * `step_set` leaves the proposal open (the landed ones are skipped as moved on a retry). A dismiss is refused once
783  * any correction of that proposal has landed. Second-look rows are noted, never written. No model; no strip write.
784  */
785 function repairAct(opts, project_path, lifecycle, verb_name) {
786   const base = { spelling: SPELLING, verb: verb_name, primary: 'update', project_path };
787   const otherFields = Object.keys(opts.face_patch ?? {}).length
788     || Object.keys(opts.strip_tip && typeof opts.strip_tip === 'object' ? opts.strip_tip : {}).length
789     || !!opts.current_step_id || !!opts.leave || !!opts.horizon || (opts.repair_propose && opts.repair_resolve);
790   if (otherFields) {
791     return { ok: false, error: 'repair_exclusive', ...base, message: 'A repair act travels alone: no other field on the same update.' };
792   }
793   if (!lifecycle.ok || !Array.isArray(lifecycle.roadmap?.roadmap_events)) {
794     return { ok: false, error: 'no_roadmap', ...base, message: 'A repair needs the roadmap.' };
795   }
796   const events = lifecycle.roadmap.roadmap_events;
797   const projection = Array.isArray(lifecycle.roadmap.roadmap_projection) ? lifecycle.roadmap.roadmap_projection : [];
798   const dry = Boolean(opts.dry_run) || opts.persist === false;
799 
800   if (opts.repair_propose) {
801     const step = String(opts.after_step ?? '').trim();
802     if (!step) return { ok: false, error: 'repair_needs_step', ...base, message: '--repair-propose needs --after-step <id>.' };
803     const last = events.length ? events[events.length - 1] : null;
804     const lastSeq = last && typeof last.seq === 'number' ? last.seq : 0;
805     let state = null;
806     try { state = foldRefinements(events); } catch (e) {
807       // a fold that throws is not "no pins": the set would be partial (Grok W4)
808       return { ok: false, error: 'refinement_fold_failed', step_id: step, ...base, message: `The refinement state could not be folded: ${e?.message ?? e}` };
809     }
810     const composed = composeRepairProposal({ projection, accepted_step_id: step,
811       accepted_presentation_id: typeof opts.after_presentation === 'string' && opts.after_presentation.trim() ? opts.after_presentation.trim() : null,
812       refinement_state: state, after_seq: lastSeq });
813     if (!composed.ok) return { ok: false, error: 'unknown_step', step_id: step, ...base, message: composed.reason };
814     const open = openRepairProposals(events);
815     const prior = open.find((e) => e.after && typeof e.after === 'object' && String(e.after.step_id) === step);
816     // the same set already open (a retried route): answered, never a twin
817     if (prior && sameRepairSet(prior, composed.proposal)) {
818       return { ok: true, existing: true, appended: false, proposal_id: String(prior.proposal_id), count: Number(prior.count) || 0, ...base,
819                message: `That set is already proposed (${prior.proposal_id}); his word is still awaited.` };
820     }
821     if (dry) return { ok: true, dry_run: true, appended: false, proposal: composed.proposal, corrections: composed.corrections, supersedes: prior ? String(prior.proposal_id) : null, ...base };
822     let superseded = null;
823     if (prior) {
824       // a later acceptance on the same step: the old set is closed as superseded (nothing written to any step) and
825       // the new composition follows — even an empty one supersedes (Grok W4)
826       const sup = appendRoadmapEventThroughSpine(project_path, { kind: 'repair_resolve', proposal_id: String(prior.proposal_id), disposition: 'superseded',
827         receipt: { who: 'steward', why: `a later acceptance on ${step}` }, applied: [], skipped: [], superseded_by: composed.empty ? null : composed.proposal.proposal_id }, { skip_index: true });
828       if (!sup.ok) return { ...sup, ...base, appended: false };
829       superseded = String(prior.proposal_id);
830     }
831     if (composed.empty) {
832       return { ok: true, empty: true, appended: false, superseded, proposal: composed.proposal, ...base,
833                message: `Nothing to correct after ${step}; no proposal appended${superseded ? ` (${superseded} superseded)` : ''}.` };
834     }
835     const res = appendRoadmapEventThroughSpine(project_path, { ...composed.proposal }, { skip_index: true });
836     if (!res.ok) return { ...res, ...base, appended: false, superseded };
837     return { ok: true, appended: true, superseded, proposal_id: composed.proposal.proposal_id, count: composed.proposal.count, corrections: composed.corrections, ...base,
838              message: `Proposed ${composed.proposal.count} correction${composed.proposal.count === 1 ? '' : 's'} after ${step}; nothing changes until his word.` };
839   }
840 
841   const proposal_id = String(opts.repair_resolve ?? '').trim();
842   const disposition = String(opts.disposition ?? '').trim();
843   if (!['accepted', 'dismissed'].includes(disposition)) {
844     return { ok: false, error: 'bad_disposition', proposal_id, ...base, message: '--disposition is accepted or dismissed.' };
845   }
846   const who = String(opts.who ?? '').trim();
847   if (!who) return { ok: false, error: 'repair_needs_who', proposal_id, ...base, message: 'His word carries a name: --who <name>.' };
848   const prop = events.find((e) => e && e.kind === 'repair_proposal' && String(e.proposal_id) === proposal_id);
849   if (!prop) return { ok: false, error: 'unknown_proposal', proposal_id, ...base, message: `No proposal ${proposal_id} in the roadmap.` };
850   if (!openRepairProposals(events).some((e) => String(e.proposal_id) === proposal_id)) {
851     return { ok: false, error: 'proposal_resolved', proposal_id, ...base, message: `Proposal ${proposal_id} already has his word.` };
852   }
853   const landedBefore = events.filter((e) => e && e.kind === 'step_set' && String(e.repair_of ?? '') === proposal_id).map((e) => String(e.step_id));
854   if (disposition === 'dismissed' && landedBefore.length) {
855     return { ok: false, error: 'repair_partly_applied', proposal_id, applied: landedBefore, ...base,
856              message: `${landedBefore.length} correction${landedBefore.length === 1 ? '' : 's'} of ${proposal_id} already landed; accept finishes the set.` };
857   }
858   const plan = disposition === 'accepted' ? planRepairApply({ projection, proposal: prop }) : { apply: [], skipped: [], noted: [] };
859   const afterStep = prop.after && typeof prop.after === 'object' ? String(prop.after.step_id ?? '') : '';
860   const why = typeof opts.reason === 'string' && opts.reason.trim() ? opts.reason.trim()
861     : `${disposition} the correction set after ${afterStep || 'the acceptance'}`;
862   if (dry) return { ok: true, dry_run: true, disposition, proposal_id, apply: plan.apply, skipped: plan.skipped, noted: plan.noted, ...base };
863   // the corrections land FIRST; his word is appended only over what landed (Grok W4: the record tells the truth)
864   const applied = [...landedBefore];
865   for (const c of plan.apply) {
866     const sres = appendRoadmapEventThroughSpine(project_path,
867       { kind: 'step_set', step_id: c.step_id, fields: c.fields, receipt: { who, why: `repair ${proposal_id}: ${c.why}` }, repair_of: proposal_id },
868       { skip_index: true });
869     if (!sres.ok) {
870       return { ...sres, ...base, resolved: false, disposition, proposal_id, applied, skipped: plan.skipped, noted: plan.noted,
871                message: `The correction on ${c.step_id} failed after ${applied.length} landed; the set stays open — accept again finishes it.` };
872     }
873     applied.push(c.step_id);
874   }
875   const rres = appendRoadmapEventThroughSpine(project_path, { kind: 'repair_resolve', proposal_id, disposition, receipt: { who, why },
876     applied, skipped: plan.skipped, noted: plan.noted }, { skip_index: true });
877   if (!rres.ok) return { ...rres, ...base, resolved: false, disposition, proposal_id, applied, skipped: plan.skipped, noted: plan.noted };
878   return { ok: true, resolved: true, disposition, proposal_id, applied, skipped: plan.skipped, noted: plan.noted, ...base,
879            message: disposition === 'accepted'
880              ? `Accepted: ${applied.length} correction${applied.length === 1 ? '' : 's'} applied${plan.skipped.length ? `, ${plan.skipped.length} skipped (moved since)` : ''}${plan.noted.length ? `, ${plan.noted.length} noted for a second look` : ''}.`
881              : 'Dismissed: nothing changed.' };
882 }

884 export function verbUpdate(opts = {}) {
885   const verb_name = opts.verb_name ?? 'update';
886   const project_path = resolveProjectPath({
887     project: opts.project,
888     cwd: opts.cwd,
889   });
890   const surfaces = opts.surfaces ?? loadProjectSurfaces(project_path);
891   const lifecycle = loadProjectRoadmap(project_path);
892   const managed = lifecycle.ok && lifecycle.roadmap?.roadmap_events?.some(e=>e.kind==='refinement_update');
893   if(managed && [opts.face_patch,opts.strip_tip,opts.strip_in_place_patch].some(p=>p &&
894       (Object.hasOwn(p,'human_wait') || Object.hasOwn(p,'pending_request') || Object.hasOwn(p,'wait_ref')))) {
895     return {ok:false,error:'managed-wait-event-owned',message:'Use refinement-update; a stamp cannot change managed human wait.'};
896   }
897   // W0 (2026-09-28): a wait's subject is a typed reference or 'none' — never free prose
898   const wait_ref_in = opts.strip_tip && typeof opts.strip_tip === 'object' ? opts.strip_tip.wait_ref : undefined;
899   if (wait_ref_in !== undefined && !isWaitRef(wait_ref_in)) {
900     return { ok: false, error: 'bad_wait_ref', wait_ref: wait_ref_in, spelling: SPELLING, verb: verb_name, primary: 'update', project_path,
901              message: '--wait-ref must be step:<id>, deliverable:<row>@<version>, decision:<id>, or none.' };
902   }
903   // W4 (2026-09-28): a repair act is a roadmap act and travels alone
904   if (opts.repair_propose || opts.repair_resolve) {
905     return repairAct(opts, project_path, lifecycle, verb_name);
906   }
907 
908   if (!surfaces.strip && !surfaces.face) {
909     return {
910       ok: false,
911       error: 'no_face_or_strip',
912       spelling: SPELLING,
913       verb: verb_name,
914       primary: 'update',
915       project_path,
916       message: 'update/heartbeat needs Face or Strip',
917     };
918   }
919 
920   // W3 (2026-09-28): --horizon derives the line from the plan — the focus, then what follows it — and writes it as a
921   // stamped instrument (the roadmap's last seq and the focus it derived from). A record whose stamp already covers
922   // the last event with the same focus is unchanged: no write. The focus read is the strip's CURRENT one, so a focus
923   // change he made is honoured, never overridden. Deterministic; no model.
924   let horizon = null;
925   if (opts.horizon) {
926     const proj = lifecycle.ok && Array.isArray(lifecycle.roadmap?.roadmap_projection) ? lifecycle.roadmap.roadmap_projection : [];
927     const evs = lifecycle.ok && Array.isArray(lifecycle.roadmap?.roadmap_events) ? lifecycle.roadmap.roadmap_events : [];
928     const lastEv = evs.length ? evs[evs.length - 1] : null;
929     const focusId = opts.current_step_id ?? surfaces.strip?.current_step_id ?? null;
930     horizon = deriveHorizon({ projection: proj, current_step_id: focusId, n: 3, last_event: lastEv, reason: opts.horizon_reason });
931     if (!horizon.ok) {
932       return { ok: false, error: 'no_horizon', reason: horizon.reason, spelling: SPELLING, verb: verb_name, primary: 'update', project_path,
933                message: `No horizon can be derived: ${horizon.reason}.` };
934     }
935     const lastSeq = lastEv && typeof lastEv.seq === 'number' ? lastEv.seq : 0;
936     const stampedSeq = surfaces.strip?.horizon_source_seq;
937     const whyOut = horizon.why ?? (surfaces.strip?.why_next ?? '');
938     const otherFields = Object.keys(opts.strip_tip && typeof opts.strip_tip === 'object' ? opts.strip_tip : {}).length
939       || Object.keys(opts.face_patch ?? {}).length || !!opts.current_step_id || !!opts.leave;
940     // unchanged (no write) only when the stamp covers the last event with the same focus AND the line and why on
941     // the strip already equal the derivation AND the call changes nothing else — a later edit of the line by
942     // another update clears the stamp (below), so it can never freeze an old line (Grok W3)
943     if (!opts.force && !otherFields && typeof stampedSeq === 'number' && stampedSeq >= lastSeq
944         && surfaces.strip?.horizon_focus === horizon.focus
945         && surfaces.strip?.next_recommended === horizon.line && String(surfaces.strip?.why_next ?? '') === String(whyOut)) {
946       return { ok: true, unchanged: true, horizon, spelling: SPELLING, verb: verb_name, primary: 'update', project_path };
947     }
948     opts = { ...opts, strip_tip: { ...(opts.strip_tip && typeof opts.strip_tip === 'object' ? opts.strip_tip : {}),
949       next_recommended: horizon.line, why_next: whyOut, horizon_source_seq: lastSeq, horizon_focus: horizon.focus, horizon_steps: horizon.steps } };
950   } else if (opts.strip_tip && typeof opts.strip_tip === 'object'
951              && (opts.strip_tip.next_recommended != null || opts.strip_tip.why_next != null || (opts.face_patch && opts.face_patch.why_next != null))) {
952     // a line written by hand (the turn's, his) is not the derived one: the stamp clears so the next --horizon
953     // re-derives rather than reporting "unchanged" over it
954     opts = { ...opts, strip_tip: { ...opts.strip_tip, horizon_source_seq: null, horizon_focus: null } };
955   }
956   // the strip's next / why / wait are capped by words (the lead line must fit)
957   const face_patch0 = opts.face_patch ?? {};
958   const tip0 = opts.strip_tip && typeof opts.strip_tip === 'object' ? opts.strip_tip : {};
959   for (const [field, value] of [['next_recommended', tip0.next_recommended], ['why_next', tip0.why_next ?? face_patch0.why_next],
960                                 ['human_wait', tip0.human_wait ?? face_patch0.human_wait]]) {
961     const over = overCap(field, value);
962     if (over) {
963       return { ok: false, error: 'over_cap', ...over, spelling: SPELLING, verb: verb_name, primary: 'update', project_path,
964                message: `${field} is ${over.words} words; the cap is ${over.cap}. Say it shorter.` };
965     }
966   }
967   // --current-step pins the step that follows; a pin needs a next and a why
968   const pin_id = typeof opts.current_step_id === 'string' && opts.current_step_id.trim() ? opts.current_step_id.trim() : null;
969   let pin_steps = null;
970   if (pin_id) {
971     pin_steps = lifecycle.ok && Array.isArray(lifecycle.roadmap?.roadmap_projection) ? lifecycle.roadmap.roadmap_projection : [];
972     if (!pin_steps.some((st) => st && st.id === pin_id)) {
973       return { ok: false, error: 'unknown_step', step_id: pin_id, spelling: SPELLING, verb: verb_name, primary: 'update', project_path,
974                message: `--current-step ${pin_id}: no such step in the roadmap.` };
975     }
976     const missing = missingSpine(surfaces.strip, { next_recommended: tip0.next_recommended, why_next: tip0.why_next ?? face_patch0.why_next });
977     if (missing.length) {
978       return { ok: false, error: 'spine_required', missing, spelling: SPELLING, verb: verb_name, primary: 'update', project_path,
979                message: 'A pin needs a next and a why: pass --next-recommended and --strip-why-next (or have them on the strip).' };
980     }
981   }
982 
983   const prior_as_of = surfaces.strip?.as_of ?? null;
984   const prior_instruments = Array.isArray(surfaces.strip?.instruments)
985     ? surfaces.strip.instruments.map((e) => ({ ...e }))
986     : [];
987   const prior_receipts = Array.isArray(surfaces.strip?.receipts)
988     ? surfaces.strip.receipts.map((e) => ({ ...e }))
989     : [];
990   const prior_instruments_len = prior_instruments.length;
991   const prior_receipts_len = prior_receipts.length;
992 
993   // Reject any attempt to silently rewrite Strip clocks in place
994   if (opts.strip_in_place_patch && Object.keys(opts.strip_in_place_patch).length) {
995     const rejected = mutateStripInPlace(surfaces.strip, opts.strip_in_place_patch);
996     return {
997       ...rejected,
998       spelling: SPELLING,
999       verb: verb_name,
1000       primary: 'update',
1001       project_path,
1002     };
1003   }
1004 
1005   const face_patch = opts.face_patch ?? {};
1006   const face_result =
1007     Object.keys(face_patch).length > 0
1008       ? rewriteFaceNarrative(surfaces.face?.narrative ?? {}, face_patch)
1009       : {
1010           ok: true,
1011           authority: 'face_human_narrative',
1012           narrative: surfaces.face?.narrative ?? {},
1013           rewritten: [],
1014         };
1015 
1016   let strip = surfaces.strip ? { ...surfaces.strip } : null;
1017   let strip_append = null;
1018   let receipt_append = null;
1019 
1020   // W0: a bare `--leave` records where he left and moves no clock — no instrument, one receipt
1021   const leave_only = !!opts.leave && !Object.keys(face_patch).length && !pin_id
1022     && !(opts.strip_tip && typeof opts.strip_tip === 'object' && Object.keys(opts.strip_tip).length);
1023   if (strip && opts.leave) {
1024     const events = lifecycle.ok && Array.isArray(lifecycle.roadmap?.roadmap_events) ? lifecycle.roadmap.roadmap_events : [];
1025     const last = events.length ? events[events.length - 1] : null;
1026     // the deliverable version he was on: copied ONLY when the last event already carries one (a refinement
1027     // event's presentation), never invented (Grok W0)
1028     const op = last && last.kind === 'refinement_update' && last.operation && typeof last.operation === 'object' ? last.operation : null;
1029     const presentation = op ? (op.presentation_id ?? op.base_presentation_id ?? null) : null;
1030     const receipt = {
1031       schema: RECEIPT_SCHEMA_ID,
1032       kind: 'leave',
1033       as_of: opts.as_of ?? todayIso(),
1034       at: typeof opts.leave_at === 'string' && opts.leave_at.trim() ? opts.leave_at.trim() : new Date().toISOString(),
1035       current_step_id: strip.current_step_id ?? null,
1036       last_event_seq: last?.seq ?? null,
1037       last_event_at: last?.at ?? null,
1038       last_event_kind: last?.kind ?? null,
1039       last_event_step_id: last?.step_id ?? op?.step_id ?? null,
1040       presentation_id: presentation,
1041       active_effort: strip.active_effort ?? null,
1042       wait_ref: strip.wait_ref ?? null,
1043       human_wait: strip.human_wait ?? 'none',
1044     };
1045     const rec = appendStripReceipt(strip, receipt, { apply_to_projection: false });
1046     if (!rec.ok) {
1047       return { ok: false, error: rec.error, spelling: SPELLING, verb: verb_name, primary: 'update', message: 'Leave receipt append failed' };
1048     }
1049     strip = rec.strip;
1050     receipt_append = receipt;
1051   }
1052 
1053   if (strip && !leave_only) {
1054     const instrument = {
1055       _kind: 'instrument',
1056       kind: verb_name === 'heartbeat' ? 'heartbeat' : (horizon ? 'horizon' : 'update'),
1057       as_of: opts.as_of ?? todayIso(),
1058       source: horizon ? 'verb_update:horizon' : 'verb_update',
1059       ...(horizon ? { derived: true } : {}),
1060       ...(opts.strip_tip && typeof opts.strip_tip === 'object' ? opts.strip_tip : {}),
1061     };
1062     // Map face active_effort / human_wait into strip tip when provided
1063     if (face_patch.active_effort != null) instrument.active_effort = face_patch.active_effort;
1064     if (face_patch.human_wait != null) instrument.human_wait = face_patch.human_wait;
1065     if (face_patch.why_next != null && instrument.why_next == null) {
1066       instrument.why_next = face_patch.why_next;
1067     }
1068     if (pin_id) instrument.current_step_id = pin_id;
1069 
1070     const appended = appendStripInstrument(strip, instrument, { apply_to_projection: true });
1071     if (!appended.ok) {
1072       return {
1073         ok: false,
1074         error: appended.error,
1075         spelling: SPELLING,
1076         verb: verb_name,
1077         primary: 'update',
1078         message: 'Strip instrument append failed',
1079       };
1080     }
1081     strip = appended.strip;
1082     strip_append = instrument;
1083 
1084     // Heartbeat also leaves a structured receipt
1085     if (verb_name === 'heartbeat' || opts.append_receipt) {
1086       const receipt = {
1087         schema: RECEIPT_SCHEMA_ID,
1088         kind: 'heartbeat',
1089         as_of: instrument.as_of,
1090         active_effort: strip.active_effort ?? null,
1091         why_next: strip.why_next ?? null,
1092         human_wait: strip.human_wait ?? 'none',
1093         uncertainty_flags: Array.isArray(strip.uncertainty_flags)
1094           ? [...strip.uncertainty_flags]
1095           : [],
1096       };
1097       const rec = appendStripReceipt(strip, receipt, { apply_to_projection: false });
1098       if (rec.ok) {
1099         strip = rec.strip;
1100         receipt_append = receipt;
1101       }
1102     }
1103   }
1104 
1105   // Prove prior history clocks were not rewritten: prior entries deep-equal prefix
1106   const history_intact =
1107     !strip ||
1108     (Array.isArray(strip.instruments) &&
1109       prior_instruments.every((e, i) => stableEqual(strip.instruments[i], e)) &&
1110       prior_receipts.every((e, i) => stableEqual(strip.receipts[i], e)));
1111 
1112   const persist = opts.persist !== false && !opts.dry_run;
1113   const written = { face: false, strip: false };
1114   if (persist && !opts.surfaces) {
1115     if (face_result.rewritten.length && surfaces.face_path) {
1116       writeFaceNarrative(surfaces.face_path, face_result.narrative, surfaces.face?.raw);
1117       written.face = true;
1118     } else if (face_result.rewritten.length) {
1119       const facePath = path.join(project_path, FACE_FILE_NAME);
1120       writeFaceNarrative(facePath, face_result.narrative, surfaces.face?.raw);
1121       written.face = true;
1122     }
1123     if (strip && surfaces.strip_source === 'strip.json') {
1124       const stripPath = surfaces.strip_path ?? path.join(project_path, STRIP_FILE_NAME);
1125       // Atomic: this is the append-only receipt ledger, and the bridge caller
1126       // can be KILLED on timeout — a truncated write here loses receipts.
1127       writeFileAtomicSync(stripPath, `${JSON.stringify(strip, null, 2)}\n`);
1128       written.strip = true;
1129     }
1130     // the same call pins the roadmap: navigation.current on the step that follows, off the rest
1131     if (pin_id) {
1132       written.pinned = pin_id;
1133       written.unpinned = [];
1134       // a step without a course navigation is pinned by the strip alone (the reader's current_step_id comes first)
1135       for (const st of pin_steps) {
1136         const nav = st.navigation && typeof st.navigation === 'object' ? st.navigation : null;
1137         const isTarget = st.id === pin_id;
1138         if (!nav) continue;
1139         if (!isTarget && nav.current !== true) continue;
1140         if (isTarget && nav.current === true) continue;
1141         const res = appendRoadmapEventThroughSpine(project_path,
1142           { kind: 'step_set', step_id: st.id, fields: { navigation: { ...nav, current: isTarget } } }, { skip_index: true });
1143         if (!res.ok) return { ...res, verb: verb_name, primary: 'update', project_path, pinned: false };
1144         if (!isTarget) written.unpinned.push(st.id);
1145       }
1146     }
1147     // TW2 precompute hook: brief cache is a declared projection (zero write
1148     // authority) refreshed at update/heartbeat time so the packet opens with
1149     // zero further gathering. Opt-in via --precompute-brief.
1150     if (opts.precompute_brief) {
1151       precomputeBriefCache(project_path);
1152       written.brief_cache = true;
1153     }
1154   }
1155 
1156   return {
1157     ok: true,
1158     spelling: SPELLING,
1159     verb: verb_name,
1160     primary: 'update',
1161     project_path,
1162     authority: {
1163       face: 'human_narrative_rewrite',
1164       strip: 'append_only',
1165     },
1166     face: face_result,
1167     strip,
1168     strip_append,
1169     receipt_append,
1170     prior_as_of,
1171     prior_instruments_length: prior_instruments_len,
1172     prior_receipts_length: prior_receipts_len,
1173     instruments_length: strip?.instruments?.length ?? 0,
1174     receipts_length: strip?.receipts?.length ?? 0,
1175     history_intact,
1176     strip_history_rewritten: !history_intact,
1177     persisted: written,
1178     dry_run: Boolean(opts.dry_run) || opts.persist === false,
1179     message: 'Face narrative updated where patched; Strip history append-only',
1180   };
1181 }
1182 
1183 /**
1184  * soft-vet / grasscatch — park idea with reason; grasscatch entry + receipt fields.
1185  * @param {object} opts
1186  * @param {string} [opts.verb_name='soft-vet']
1187  */
1188 export function verbSoftVet(opts = {}) {
1189   const verb_name = opts.verb_name ?? 'soft-vet';
1190   const kind = verb_name === 'grasscatch' ? 'grasscatch' : 'soft-vet';
1191   const deferred = opts.deferred ?? opts.what ?? opts.rest?.[0] ?? null;
1192   const why = opts.reason ?? opts.why ?? opts.rest?.[1] ?? null;
1193 
1194   if (!deferred || !why) {
1195     return {
1196       ok: false,
1197       error: 'soft_vet_requires_reason',
1198       spelling: SPELLING,
1199       verb: verb_name,
1200       primary: 'soft-vet',
1201       message:
1202         'soft-vet/grasscatch requires deferred item and reason (what deferred + why). Use --deferred and --reason.',
1203       required: ['deferred', 'reason'],
1204     };
1205   }
1206 
1207   const project_path = resolveProjectPath({
1208     project: opts.project,
1209     cwd: opts.cwd,
1210   });
1211   const surfaces = opts.surfaces ?? loadProjectSurfaces(project_path);
1212 
1213   if (!surfaces.strip) {
1214     return {
1215       ok: false,
1216       error: 'no_strip',
1217       spelling: SPELLING,
1218       verb: verb_name,
1219       primary: 'soft-vet',
1220       project_path,
1221       message: 'soft-vet/grasscatch requires a Strip to append grasscatch + receipt',
1222     };
1223   }
1224 
1225   const prior_as_of = surfaces.strip.as_of;
1226   const prior_instruments = Array.isArray(surfaces.strip.instruments)
1227     ? surfaces.strip.instruments.map((e) => ({ ...e }))
1228     : [];
1229   const prior_receipts = Array.isArray(surfaces.strip.receipts)
1230     ? surfaces.strip.receipts.map((e) => ({ ...e }))
1231     : [];
1232   const prior_grasscatch = Array.isArray(surfaces.strip.grasscatch)
1233     ? [...surfaces.strip.grasscatch]
1234     : [];
1235 
1236   // Soft-vet fills receipt cells only — never launches specialists (W4)
1237   const uncertainty_flags = Array.isArray(surfaces.strip.uncertainty_flags)
1238     ? [...surfaces.strip.uncertainty_flags]
1239     : [];
1240   const receipt = buildGrasscatchReceipt({
1241     kind,
1242     deferred,
1243     why,
1244     handback_shape: opts.handback_shape ?? {
1245       when: 'later',
1246       return_via: 'strip_receipt',
1247       needs: [
1248         'active_effort',
1249         'why_next',
1250         'grasscatch_why',
1251         'tool_depth_why',
1252         'human_wait',
1253         'uncertainty_flags',
1254       ],
1255       what_deferred: deferred,
1256       why,
1257       suggested_later_owner: opts.suggested_later_owner ?? null,
1258     },
1259     suggested_later_owner: opts.suggested_later_owner ?? null,
1260     as_of: opts.as_of ?? todayIso(),
1261     active_effort: surfaces.strip.active_effort ?? null,
1262     uncertainty_flags,
1263     tool_depth_why: opts.tool_depth_why ?? null,
1264   });
1265 
1266   // Append instrument that unions grasscatch list (append-union, never drop prior)
1267   const instrument = {
1268     _kind: 'instrument',
1269     kind,
1270     as_of: receipt.as_of,
1271     grasscatch: [deferred],
1272     deferred,
1273     why,
1274     grasscatch_why: why,
1275     suggested_later_owner: receipt.suggested_later_owner,
1276     uncertainty_flags: receipt.uncertainty_flags,
1277     handback_shape: receipt.handback_shape,
1278   };
1279 
1280   const inst = appendStripInstrument(surfaces.strip, instrument, { apply_to_projection: true });
1281   if (!inst.ok) {
1282     return { ok: false, error: inst.error, spelling: SPELLING, verb: verb_name, primary: 'soft-vet' };
1283   }
1284 
1285   const rec = appendStripReceipt(inst.strip, receipt, { apply_to_projection: false });
1286   if (!rec.ok) {
1287     return { ok: false, error: rec.error, spelling: SPELLING, verb: verb_name, primary: 'soft-vet' };
1288   }
1289 
1290   const strip = rec.strip;
1291   const history_intact =
1292     prior_instruments.every((e, i) => stableEqual(strip.instruments[i], e)) &&
1293     prior_receipts.every((e, i) => stableEqual(strip.receipts[i], e));
1294 
1295   // Prior grasscatch labels must still be present (append-union)
1296   const grasscatch_prior_intact = prior_grasscatch.every((g) =>
1297     (strip.grasscatch || []).includes(g),
1298   );
1299 
1300   const persist = opts.persist !== false && !opts.dry_run;
1301   const written = { strip: false };
1302   if (persist && !opts.surfaces && surfaces.strip_source === 'strip.json') {
1303     const stripPath = surfaces.strip_path ?? path.join(project_path, STRIP_FILE_NAME);
1304     // Atomic: same receipt ledger, second writer. (Found by the W16 gate —
1305     // the first pass fixed only one of the two strip writers in this file.)
1306     writeFileAtomicSync(stripPath, `${JSON.stringify(strip, null, 2)}\n`);
1307     written.strip = true;
1308   }
1309 
1310   return {
1311     ok: true,
1312     spelling: SPELLING,
1313     verb: verb_name,
1314     primary: 'soft-vet',
1315     project_path,
1316     parked: {
1317       deferred,
1318       why,
1319       suggested_later_owner: receipt.suggested_later_owner,
1320       uncertainty_flags: receipt.uncertainty_flags,
1321       handback_shape: receipt.handback_shape,
1322     },
1323     receipt,
1324     strip,
1325     prior_as_of,
1326     prior_grasscatch,
1327     grasscatch: strip.grasscatch,
1328     history_intact,
1329     grasscatch_prior_intact,
1330     strip_history_rewritten: !history_intact,
1331     // soft-vet fills cells only — never commissions or launches specialists
1332     launches_specialists: false,
1333     commission: null,
1334     specialists_launched: [],
1335     persisted: written,
1336     dry_run: Boolean(opts.dry_run) || opts.persist === false,
1337     message: `Parked via ${kind}: grasscatch entry + receipt appended (Strip history intact; no specialist launch)`,
1338   };
1339 }

1341 /**
1342  * receipt-validate — structured schema only; monologue-only invalid.
1343  * @param {object} opts
1344  */
1345 export function verbReceiptValidate(opts = {}) {
1346   let input = opts.receipt;
1347   if (input == null && opts.receipt_raw != null) input = opts.receipt_raw;
1348   if (input == null && opts.rest?.length) {
1349     // First free arg may be JSON or monologue
1350     input = opts.rest.join(' ');
1351   }
1352   if (opts.receipt_error) {
1353     return {
1354       ok: false,
1355       error: 'receipt_read_failed',
1356       spelling: SPELLING,
1357       verb: 'receipt-validate',
1358       primary: 'receipt-validate',
1359       message: opts.receipt_error,
1360     };
1361   }
1362   if (input == null || input === '') {
1363     return {
1364       ok: false,
1365       error: 'receipt_missing',
1366       spelling: SPELLING,
1367       verb: 'receipt-validate',
1368       primary: 'receipt-validate',
1369       message: 'receipt-validate requires --receipt JSON or --receipt-file',
1370     };
1371   }
1372 
1373   // Explicit monologue path
1374   if (typeof input === 'string' && isMonologueOnly(input)) {
1375     return {
1376       ok: false,
1377       error: 'monologue_only_invalid',
1378       spelling: SPELLING,
1379       verb: 'receipt-validate',
1380       primary: 'receipt-validate',
1381       valid: false,
1382       message:
1383         'Monologue-only receipt is invalid; provide structured schema/kind/as_of fields.',
1384     };
1385   }
1386 
1387   const result = validateReceipt(input);
1388   if (!result.ok) {
1389     return {
1390       ok: false,
1391       error: result.error,
1392       spelling: SPELLING,
1393       verb: 'receipt-validate',
1394       primary: 'receipt-validate',
1395       valid: false,
1396       issues: result.issues,
1397       message: result.message,
1398     };
1399   }
1400 
1401   return {
1402     ok: true,
1403     spelling: SPELLING,
1404     verb: 'receipt-validate',
1405     primary: 'receipt-validate',
1406     valid: true,
1407     receipt: result.receipt,
1408     schema_id: result.schema_id,
1409     monologue: false,
1410     message: 'Receipt passed structured schema validation',
1411   };
1412 }

1414 /**
1415  * depth-suggest — fully table-driven (W4).
1416  * Reads Strip signals + dispatch table only. Defaults LITE bias.
1417  * Free-form depth inflation refused. Human override requires structured receipt.
1418  * @param {object} opts
1419  */
1420 export function verbDepthSuggest(opts = {}) {
1421   // Free-form depth inflation refused (argv/opts LITE|FULL|SPIKE without table path)
1422   const freeForm =
1423     opts.depth ??
1424     opts.inflate ??
1425     opts.rest?.find((t) => /^(LITE|FULL|SPIKE|commission|refuse)$/i.test(t));
1426 
1427   if (freeForm && opts.allow_free_form !== true) {
1428     return {
1429       ok: false,
1430       error: 'free_form_depth_refused',
1431       spelling: SPELLING,
1432       verb: 'depth-suggest',
1433       primary: 'depth-suggest',
1434       message:
1435         'Free-form depth inflation refused. depth-suggest is table-driven; no ad-hoc LITE|FULL|SPIKE from argv. Use Strip signals + table, or a structured override receipt (who/when/why/from→to).',
1436       refused_value: freeForm,
1437       table_ready: true,
1438     };
1439   }
1440 
1441   const table = opts.table ?? loadDispatchTable();
1442   let strip = null;
1443   let project_path = null;
1444   if (opts.signals && typeof opts.signals === 'object') {
1445     strip = opts.signals;
1446   } else if (opts.project || opts.surfaces || opts.cwd) {
1447     project_path = resolveProjectPath({
1448       project: opts.project,
1449       cwd: opts.cwd,
1450     });
1451     const surfaces = opts.surfaces ?? loadProjectSurfaces(project_path);
1452     strip = surfaces.strip ?? null;
1453   }
1454 
1455   const suggested = suggestDepthFromStrip(strip, { table });
1456   // Rank-adjacent flags when capacity unknown (never silent green)
1457   let rank_flags = null;
1458   if (strip) {
1459     const proj = toStripProjection(strip, { project_path });
1460     if (proj) {
1461       const scored = scoreStripProjection(proj);
1462       rank_flags = scored.flags;
1463     }
1464   }
1465 
1466   let outcome = suggested.outcome;
1467   let override_applied = null;
1468   let tool_depth_why = suggested.tool_depth_why;
1469 
1470   // Human override of table outcome requires structured receipt reason
1471   if (opts.override != null || opts.override_receipt != null) {
1472     const ovRaw = opts.override_receipt ?? opts.override;
1473     let ovReceipt = ovRaw;
1474     if (typeof ovRaw === 'string') {
1475       try {
1476         ovReceipt = JSON.parse(ovRaw);
1477       } catch {
1478         return {
1479           ok: false,
1480           error: 'override_receipt_invalid',
1481           spelling: SPELLING,
1482           verb: 'depth-suggest',
1483           primary: 'depth-suggest',
1484           table_ready: true,
1485           table_outcome: suggested.outcome,
1486           message:
1487             'Override without structured receipt fails. Provide override receipt with who/when/why/from→to.',
1488         };
1489       }
1490     }
1491 
1492     // Accept either full receipt or bare override object
1493     const reason =
1494       ovReceipt && typeof ovReceipt === 'object'
1495         ? ovReceipt.override && typeof ovReceipt.override === 'object'
1496           ? ovReceipt.override
1497           : ovReceipt
1498         : null;
1499 
1500     if (!reason || typeof reason !== 'object') {
1501       return {
1502         ok: false,
1503         error: 'override_receipt_required',
1504         spelling: SPELLING,
1505         verb: 'depth-suggest',
1506         primary: 'depth-suggest',
1507         table_ready: true,
1508         table_outcome: suggested.outcome,
1509         message:
1510           'Human override of table outcome requires structured receipt reason (who/when/why/from→to).',
1511       };
1512     }
1513 
1514     // Validate as receipt when schema/kind present; otherwise field-check via applyDepthOverride
1515     if (ovReceipt.kind === 'override' || ovReceipt.schema) {
1516       const validated = validateReceipt(
1517         ovReceipt.kind
1518           ? ovReceipt
1519           : buildOverrideReceipt({
1520               ...reason,
1521               from: reason.from ?? suggested.outcome,
1522               to: reason.to,
1523             }),
1524       );
1525       if (!validated.ok) {
1526         return {
1527           ok: false,
1528           error: 'override_receipt_invalid',
1529           spelling: SPELLING,
1530           verb: 'depth-suggest',
1531           primary: 'depth-suggest',
1532           table_ready: true,
1533           table_outcome: suggested.outcome,
1534           issues: validated.issues,
1535           message: validated.message,
1536         };
1537       }
1538     }
1539 
1540     const applied = applyDepthOverride(
1541       reason.from ?? suggested.outcome,
1542       reason.to,
1543       {
1544         who: reason.who,
1545         when: reason.when,
1546         why: reason.why,
1547       },
1548     );
1549     if (!applied.ok) {
1550       return {
1551         ok: false,
1552         error: applied.error,
1553         spelling: SPELLING,
1554         verb: 'depth-suggest',
1555         primary: 'depth-suggest',
1556         table_ready: true,
1557         table_outcome: suggested.outcome,
1558         issues: applied.issues,
1559         message: applied.message,
1560       };
1561     }
1562     outcome = applied.outcome;
1563     override_applied = applied.override;
1564     tool_depth_why = applied.tool_depth_why;
1565   }
1566 
1567   const uncertainty_flags = suggested.uncertainty_flags ?? [];
1568   const receipt = buildDepthReceipt({
1569     outcome,
1570     tool_depth_why,
1571     as_of: opts.as_of ?? todayIso(),
1572     uncertainty_flags,
1573     capacity: suggested.capacity,
1574     active_effort: suggested.signals?.active_effort ?? null,
1575     dimensions: suggested.dimensions,
1576     flags: {
1577       ...suggested.flags,
1578       ...(rank_flags || {}),
1579       override: Boolean(override_applied),
1580     },
1581   });
1582 
1583   return {
1584     ok: true,
1585     spelling: SPELLING,
1586     verb: 'depth-suggest',
1587     primary: 'depth-suggest',
1588     table_ready: true,
1589     project_path,
1590     outcome,
1591     table_outcome: suggested.outcome,
1592     bias: DEFAULT_BIAS,
1593     lite_bias: Boolean(suggested.flags?.lite_bias),
1594     flags: {
1595       ...suggested.flags,
1596       rank: rank_flags,
1597       silent_full_green: false,
1598       never_silent_full_green: true,
1599     },
1600     cell: {
1601       status: 'table_ready',
1602       outcome,
1603       table_outcome: suggested.outcome,
1604       reason: tool_depth_why,
1605       tool_depth_why,
1606       signals: suggested.signals,
1607       dimensions: suggested.dimensions,
1608       matched_cell: suggested.cell,
1609       lite_bias_default: true,
1610       override: override_applied,
1611     },
1612     receipt,
1613     uncertainty_flags,
1614     capacity: suggested.capacity,
1615     rank_flags,
1616     free_form: false,
1617     message: override_applied
1618       ? `depth-suggest table ${suggested.outcome} overridden → ${outcome} (structured receipt)`
1619       : `depth-suggest table outcome ${outcome} (LITE bias; free-form refused)`,
1620     // Never silent FULL green (capacity=unknown demotes FULL in the table layer)
1621     silent_full_green: false,
1622   };
1623 }

1625 /**
1626  * Dispatch a closed primary verb to its body.
1627  * @param {string} primary
1628  * @param {object} opts
1629  */
1630 export function runClosedVerbBody(primary, opts = {}) {
1631   switch (primary) {
1632     case 'status':
1633       return verbStatus(opts);
1634     case 'next':
1635       return verbNext(opts);
1636     case 'update':
1637       return verbUpdate({ ...opts, verb_name: opts.verb_name ?? 'update' });
1638     case 'depth-suggest':
1639       return verbDepthSuggest(opts);
1640     case 'soft-vet':
1641       return verbSoftVet({ ...opts, verb_name: opts.verb_name ?? 'soft-vet' });
1642     case 'receipt-validate':
1643       return verbReceiptValidate(opts);
1644     case 'roadmap-show':
1645       return verbRoadmapShow(opts);
1646     case 'roadmap-propose':
1647       return verbRoadmapPropose(opts);
1648     case 'roadmap-set':
1649       return verbRoadmapSet(opts);
1650     case 'refinement-update':
1651       return verbRefinementUpdate(opts);
1652     case 'brief':
1653       return verbBrief(opts);
1654     case 'commission-propose':
1655       return verbCommissionPropose(opts);
1656     case 'commission-confirm':
1657       return verbCommissionConfirm(opts);
1658     case 'seat-hop':
1659       return verbSeatHop(opts);
1660     default:
1661       return {
1662         ok: false,
1663         error: 'unknown_primary',
1664         spelling: SPELLING,
1665         primary,
1666         message: `No body for primary '${primary}' (closed dispatcher only)`,
1667       };
1668   }
1669 }

1671 /**
1672  * Canary: scan engine entrypoint sources for harness markers.
1673  * Flags dependency-like paths (import/require/from) and real listen/createServer
1674  * call sites — not prose that names the ban.
1675  * @param {string} engineDir absolute or relative path to engine/
1676  * @returns {{ ok: boolean, openclaw_hits: object[], daemon_hits: object[], scanned: string[] }}
1677  */
1678 export function runHarnessCanaries(engineDir) {
1679   const dir = path.resolve(engineDir);
1680   const files = listJsFiles(dir);
1681   const openclaw_hits = [];
1682   const daemon_hits = [];
1683   const scanned = [];
1684 
1685   // Dependency path only: import/require/from "…openclaw…"
1686   const forbiddenDep =
1687     /(?:from\s+|require\s*\(\s*|import\s*\(\s*)['"`][^'"`]*openclaw[^'"`]*['"`]/i;
1688   // Real server listen loop call sites (not the word "listen" in help text)
1689   const forbiddenListen = /(?:net|http|https|dgram)?\s*\.?\s*createServer\s*\(|\b\.listen\s*\(\s*\d+/;
1690 
1691   for (const file of files) {
1692     scanned.push(path.relative(dir, file).split(path.sep).join('/'));
1693     let text;
1694     try {
1695       text = fs.readFileSync(file, 'utf8');
1696     } catch {
1697       continue;
1698     }
1699     const lines = text.split(/\r?\n/);
1700     lines.forEach((line, idx) => {
1701       const trimmed = line.trim();
1702       // Strip line comments for call-site scan
1703       const code = trimmed.replace(/\/\/.*$/, '').trim();
1704       if (!code || code.startsWith('*') || code.startsWith('/*') || code.startsWith('#')) {
1705         return;
1706       }
1707       if (forbiddenDep.test(code)) {
1708         openclaw_hits.push({
1709           file: path.basename(file),
1710           line: idx + 1,
1711           text: trimmed.slice(0, 120),
1712         });
1713       }
1714       if (forbiddenListen.test(code)) {
1715         daemon_hits.push({
1716           file: path.basename(file),
1717           line: idx + 1,
1718           text: trimmed.slice(0, 120),
1719         });
1720       }
1721     });
1722   }
1723 
1724   return {
1725     ok: openclaw_hits.length === 0 && daemon_hits.length === 0,
1726     openclaw_hits,
1727     daemon_hits,
1728     scanned,
1729     message:
1730       openclaw_hits.length || daemon_hits.length
1731         ? 'Harness canary failed'
1732         : 'No forbidden dependency paths or daemon listen loops in engine entrypoints',
1733   };
1734 }
1735 
1736 function listJsFiles(dir) {
1737   const out = [];
1738   let entries = [];
1739   try {
1740     entries = fs.readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true });
1741   } catch {
1742     return out;
1743   }
1744   for (const ent of entries) {
1745     const p = path.join(dir, ent.name);
1746     if (ent.isDirectory()) {
1747       if (ent.name === 'node_modules' || ent.name === '.git') continue;
1748       out.push(...listJsFiles(p));
1749     } else if (ent.isFile() && (ent.name.endsWith('.mjs') || ent.name.endsWith('.js'))) {
1750       out.push(p);
1751     }
1752   }
1753   return out;
1754 }

1756 /**
1757  * Rewrite Face markdown narrative sections; preserve Strip fence if present.
1758  * @param {string} facePath
1759  * @param {object} narrative
1760  * @param {string} [priorRaw]
1761  */
1762 export function writeFaceNarrative(facePath, narrative, priorRaw = '') {
1763   const prior = typeof priorRaw === 'string' ? priorRaw : '';
1764   const fence = extractFenceBlock(prior);
1765   const body = [
1766     '# Ecgberht — Face',
1767     '',
1768     '## North star',
1769     '',
1770     narrative.north_star ?? '',
1771     '',
1772     '## Active effort',
1773     '',
1774     narrative.active_effort ?? '',
1775     '',
1776     '## Why next',
1777     '',
1778     narrative.why_next ?? '',
1779     '',
1780     '## Human wait',
1781     '',
1782     narrative.human_wait ?? 'none',
1783     '',
1784   ];
1785   if (narrative.why_stakes) {
1786     body.push('## Why stakes', '', narrative.why_stakes, '');
1787   }
1788   if (fence) {
1789     body.push('## Strip (instrument)', '', '```json', fence, '```', '');
1790   }
1791   fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(facePath), { recursive: true });
1792   // Face is the human narrative surface — rewritable, but a truncated Face is
1793   // still lost work, so it gets the same atomic replacement as Strip.
1794   writeFileAtomicSync(facePath, `${body.join('\n')}\n`);
1795 }
1796 
1797 function extractFenceBlock(markdown) {
1798   if (!markdown) return null;
1799   const m = markdown.match(/```(?:json)?\s*\r?\n([\s\S]*?)```/i);
1800   if (!m) return null;
1801   const inner = m[1].trim();
1802   if (!inner.includes('ecgberht-strip') && !inner.includes('"schema"')) return null;
1803   return inner;
1804 }
1805 
1806 function stableEqual(a, b) {
1807   return JSON.stringify(a) === JSON.stringify(b);
1808 }
